div.div:
Key Idea: the environment is a learned video world model
- No physics simulator and no real robot in the training loop
- Wan generates "imagined" future frames from (obs, action, prompt)
- Reward is a world-model classifier (resnet_rm.pth) in [0, 1]
- No reset(): init frames bundled in the Wan checkpoint
- GRPO drops the critic — advantages are group-relative
- All components colocated on 1 node (8x H200)
Accuracy is measured separately in the real LIBERO simulator.
